messages.subject: Problem installing seewave, no package 'tuneR'
messages.body_plain:
Dear seewave list

I am seeking advice with the following problem:

When I follow the instructions on http://rug.mnhn.fr/seewave/, "installation"
section, I get the following error from

'install.packages(c("fftw","tuneR","rgl","rpanel"), repos="http://cran.at.r-project.org/")' (done as root)

"Fehler in library(tuneR) : es gibt kein Paket namens ‘tuneR’"
(sorry, my R is localised, means "error in library(tuneR), there is no package named
'tuneR'").

Any ideas ideas for a workaround? I am quite fond of using seewave for
analyses of cricket songs.

Best wishes, Michael

messages.body_plain:

and to install it manually with install.packages("tuneR_1.3.3.tar.gz").
Best regards,
Jerome

messages.subject: Spectrogram covariance: wave1 vs wave2 is different from wave2 vs wave1. why?
messages.subject_clean: Spectrogram covariance: wave1 vs wave2 is different from wave2 vs wave1. why?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I've been working for a while on a script to get similarity measurements between sounds. I realized that the correlation index is different when comparing wave1 to wave2 than when comparing wave2 to wave1. This is in the spectrogram covariance function: covspectro. It is also stated in the manual: "Inverting wave1 and wave2 may give slight different results".

I do not understand why is this the case, does anybody know?

Cheers
Javi

Thank you
